games.name: Derby! | Uma Musume [Open Playtest]
games.desc:
Inspired by Uma Musume.

NOTE: This Game is in Playtest, expect lots of Bugs and feel free to report the Bugs to me!

CONTROLS (PC):
- M to open Menu.

RACE CONTROLS (PC):
- Press Space to Sprint.
- When Sprinting, Hold Space then Release at the right Timing to Spurt.
- W,A,S,D to Change Direction/Turn.

CONSOLE CONTROLS:
- Press A to Sprint
- When Sprinting, Hold A then Release at the right Timing to Spurt.

MOBILE IS ALSO SUPPORTED!

Reroll your Trait at Trait Research in Menu.
It's Recommended to check your Stats to learn how your Trait Abilities Work.

Playtest Feature: You get free 3 Licenses at the Start, Participate in a Race or Predict other Player to earn License.

#Umamusume
